config = '''[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py314"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP"]

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
'''

print(config)

try:
    import tomllib
    parsed = tomllib.loads(config)
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["line-length"] == 100
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["target-version"] == "py314"
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["lint"]["select"] == ["E", "F", "I", "UP"]
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["format"]["quote-style"] == "double"
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["format"]["indent-style"] == "space"
except ImportError:
    pass

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = [
#     "polars",
#     "rich",
# ]
# ///

try:
    import polars as pl
    from rich import print
except ImportError:
    # Dependencies are normally installed by `uv run`; fall back gracefully
    pl = None

if pl is None:
    print("polars/rich not installed; run this script with `uv run script.py`")
else:
    try:
        df = pl.read_csv("data.csv")
        print(df.head(5))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print("data.csv not found")
